scene: Static crackles into singing voices across the console's glowing dials.
picture: First-person close-up of the vintage radio's control panel. At centre, a circular amber-glowing frequency display hums above a large fluted bakelite knob. On the left, a hand-annotated paper tram route is taped to the metal chassis. To the right, glowing vacuum tubes warm the casing near an upright brass toggle switch.
shown: A heavy bakelite tuning knob sitting in the centre of the console face
A faded city tram map taped to the left of the glowing dials
A gleaming brass toggle switch flicked upward on the far right
